redTestChanges.reason: The spec was wrong and amended (spec.md:427, :578; matching spec.json re-stamped) — spec.md pinned the client's outbound chat subscribe/unsubscribe frame as { type: 'chat.subscribe'|'chat.unsubscribe', conversationId }, but CH-05's real gateway (packages/shared-types's ClientToGatewayMessage; services/gateway/src/ws/protocol.ts's decodeClientMessage) only ever accepted { type: 'subscribe'|'unsubscribe', channel: 'chat', conversationId }. red faithfully pinned the wrong (spec-matching) shape at two assertions. review.md's re-gate C-1 (run against CH-05's now-real gateway) found this and directed the amendment. Two lines changed, nothing else: line 996 (teardown/unsubscribe assertion) now checks frame.type === 'unsubscribe' && frame.channel === 'chat' && frame.conversationId === 'conv_1'; line 1151 (connect/subscribe assertion) now checks frame.type === 'subscribe' && frame.channel === 'chat' && frame.conversationId === 'conv_1'. Verified via `git diff HEAD -- apps/web/app/workspace/chat/AskSayrePanel.test.tsx` that these are the only two changed lines in the file.
